title: Unit Event — The Song of a Canary in Crisis

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis
meta.Outline: As the 30th Anniversary Show approaches, Nene is hard at work preparing for her role as the Cowardly Canary. However, during a rehearsal, the director criticizes not her acting, but her singing...

rows.Line: Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, I think I have this song down.
And I'm producing high notes much better than usual...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which leaves my acting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright...
I'll try again from the top.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (First, the scene when I meet Rio for the first time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“U-Umm...
Thank you for praising my singing.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“I really love to sing...
I mean, it's how I communicate.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“No, it might be more than that...
Unfortunately, I'm not very good at talking to other people...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, that didn't sound right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We've been practicing for the 30th Anniversary Show for a while now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (After seeing those two perform, I felt that I also should do everything I can. That I need to do my best...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why I've been trying to do what Tsukasa did. I've been working on becoming the Cowardly Canary...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I watched the birds as they gathered on the trees in the park, and tried singing based on how I think they're feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As a result, compared to when we first started, I've been able to immerse myself into my characters much better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I still don't think I can put on that kind of performance.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm having a hard time seeing myself bringing my character to life the way they did....)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that's no reason to get myself down...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're supposed to start practicing scenes that include the Cowardly Canary tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Am I really gonna be ready to put on even a half-decent performance by then...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No... Not as I currently am.
So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll need to start looking for some hints tomorrow during practice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
And by the time the curtains go up...
I'll have my Cowardly Canary polished to perfection.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm gonna be as good as those two...
The next day
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Alright, as I mentioned before...
Starting today, we'll be working on the scenes where Rio meets the forest's various birds as he chases after the Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
So, from the top.
Where Rio first meets our canary.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Begin!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No, I lost her again...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “At this rate, I'm never going to catch up to her, let alone capture her...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
If only I had wings like her...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Huh?
There's something on top of that tree over there.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Is that...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(This is it!
The scene where Rio hears the canary sing for the very first time!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm so excited! I can't wait to see how Nene goes!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (At this moment, I'm not aware that Rio is there...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm singing to my heart's content. I just need to sound like I'm enjoying myself.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So that Rio's feels genuinely moved...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! Her voice is so pretty...!
It's like she's a real bird!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, she's certainly captured a canary's singing voice nicely. Going through the trouble of breaking down her character seems to have been well worth it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Who's singing? Is it that bird...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What a beautiful voice...
I'd like to hear it more up close...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“H-Huh?!
Who's there...?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Oh, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to startle you! I was just...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “N-No, stay away...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Oh... I-I'm sorry...
But please... Go somewhere else...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“I don't like humans...
Because they're always mean to me...”

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Stop there.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Rio.
You overdid it there when the canary shooed you away.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Yes, it is important to exaggerate in order to get your message across to the audience. However, there are times when that can work against you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Understood! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought Tsukasa did a really good job just now. It felt so real and yet there's still things to work on...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Which means...
How much of an earful am I gonna get?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was able to sing the first part the way I practiced it, but my acting still felt...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Next, Canary...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Your acting wasn't bad...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Yes, I thought you captured the Cowardly Canary's personality rather well.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Just work on your breathing.
As you gain a better understanding of what it means to be “cowardly”, you should be able to speak and act in a more convincing fashion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, that is all regarding your acting...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As for your singing, it simply won't do at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Your character sings two songs in total during this show. The second one in particular plays a vital role in changing how Rio and the phoenix view one another.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As your current rate, you're going to struggle to move the audience. At the moment, Kusanagi, your singing sticks out just that much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My singing...sticks out...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Please research what the Cowardly Canary is supposed to sound like for this show while keeping in mind how your lines and songs are tied together.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, our next scene has... The Great Eagle!

rows.Speaker: Omori
rows.Line: Present!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What did he mean by that...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My singing sticks out...?)
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was great, you guys!
Our morning practice was so wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, it was.
I thought the scenes with your canary were particularly notable, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You've captured your character's namesake cowardly nature very well!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought so too!
The director always looks really grumpy, but he said your acting wasn't bad!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Staying up at night to practice seems to have been worth it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is what he said about your singing bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was really happy when he praised my acting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew that my acting still needed a lot of work and had to do my best as I practiced moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I felt that I was able to produce some results today because all of you helped and gave me pointers.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It felt that way until...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Until I was told that my singing just “simply won't do”. That was a huge shock...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I bet it was...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You sang so beautifully, Nene...
And you've been putting more effort into this show than any we've done before.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think I was feeling more confident about my singing than I realized...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That might've been why I was expecting to receive more comments about my acting compared to my singing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I mean, I practiced my singing.
But if someone asked if I worked just as hard on it as I did with my acting, then probably not.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even so, I'm practicing harder than I ever have for the real thing. But still...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Was I really that bad...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've been worried ever since then...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Yes, I took a break for a while...
But I still should have more stage experience than most people my age.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (With each performance, Tsukasa just keeps getting better and better. Before I realized it, we were pretty much on the same level.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But that also has to do with me having a lot of confidence in my singing...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You've proven that you may be worthy of being our rivals. But you'll need to maintain this standard for your next show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Seiryuin specifically acknowledged me for my singing. I became convinced that I was good at something. That I had talent...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Even though my acting still leaves a lot to be desired, I was sure that my singing would more than allow me to keep up with those two...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe a little too sure...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As for your singing, it simply won't do at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to do something...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because if I don't, my canary won't come to life. Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My dream of becoming...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't wanna put on a half-baked performance...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu's right.
To me, singing means everything...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It was the one thing I thought I was good at. My only talent. So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to figure out something before the show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I have to find a solution...
A way to really sing like a canary...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My acting is at best average.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'm keenly aware of that fact.
Which is why I've been working so hard on other things to make up for it. Still...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My singing...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't wanna lose to anyone there. So...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to do everything I can.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sorry, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Nene, where are you going...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Excuse me, sir... I apologize for disturbing you during your break! I was hoping to discuss what you told me just now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you said my singing “sticks out”, what did you mean exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She certainly seems motivated...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, she does.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, it is nice to have someone comment on her singing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To be honest, I don't really know how to criticize someone's singing since I'm not all that knowledgeable.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's understandable. If anything, Nene was essentially our troupe's singing instructor.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, she's easily the best singer out of all of us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Very true. But the Phoenix Stage places an emphasis on both singing and acting...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Unlike when we put on shows by ourselves, we have an opportunity to work with some experts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's a chance to learn things that we normally wouldn't.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene stands to grow quite a bit through this show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene has been practicing super-duper hard for this show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which means she's gonna sing really, really, reeaally amazing during the show and become an extra special Nene!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We can only provide her with some words of encouragement, but let's help her however we can. Then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We can look forward to hearing just how much more beautiful the Cowardly Canary's birdsong will become!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin our afternoon practice.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Let's pick up from where we left off. The scene by the lake...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm glad I was able to talk with the director during our break.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Frankly, Kusanagi, you're just not seeing the big picture for this show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The big picture...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As I mentioned earlier, your singing sticks out.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: If it were you singing alone up there on stage, Kusanagi, you would undoubtedly be able to put on a moving performance.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: However, it would not be as the Cowardly Canary...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: But as Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Unless you change the way you sing, the scene where the canary sings will not be a scene from “The Happy Phoenix” but your own personal recital.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, what you're saying is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The way I sing could end up completely ruining our show...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Precisely.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: This isn't going to be an easy problem to solve since it will likely involve breaking some old habits.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: However, becoming aware of such habits is difficult. For as long as you remember, they were probably what your mind considered “normal” or “right”.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
This process can take quite a toll...
But if you wish to keep moving forward, you'll need to start by figuring out what your habits are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I never thought to see things from that sort of perspective until now. I always thought that my singing style suited me really well...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: However, becoming aware of such habits is difficult. For as long as you remember, they were probably what your mind considered “normal” or “right”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If the way I sing now may ruin the show, then...)

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Oh, they're starting.
I can't wait to see the scene with the Great Eagle.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Yeah, me neither.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Omori
rows.Line:
“Now, my friends, hear me sing.
Your eyes shall glimmer with hope as I bestow upon you the courage to rise!”

rows.Speaker: Omori
rows.Line:
“And dance up a storm!
Until the gloomy shroud over this forest is lifted!”
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He really sounds like a powerful eagle. The master of this forest. His voice definitely does wanna make you dance and have fun...)

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Looks like Omori's been practicing.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: And he's totally different from his usual self. It's amazing how he's captured the eagle's awe-inspiring yet comical personality.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Nishie's also been doing an amazing job.
I love how her voice oozes with evil. She's been sending shivers down my spine as the witch.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not only do the main characters sing during this show, but each of the birds also has their own song.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It tests both an actor's singing and acting abilities, which suits the cast of the Phoenix Stage really well...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which sort of explains why it was chosen for the anniversary show. Needless to say, the crowd's gonna be looking forward to seeing us sing...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The way I sing could end up completely ruining our show...?

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Precisely.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't let the way I sing ruin this show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to take a hard look at myself. I need to learn what my habits are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Because if I don't fix those, I'll never be able to sing like Omori. I have to see what the good singers are doing and find even the smallest hint.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If I can do that, maybe. Just maybe...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Fine, so be it.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
“I would rather not be a damper...
So, I shall make a special exception and sing for you.”

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: “Prepare every fiber of your being to hear the dulcet tones of my majestic voice.”

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line: Way to go, Sakurako.

rows.Speaker: Cast Members
rows.Line:
Yeah.
She's definitely got another good one in store for us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (How is she able to sing in such a compelling way?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This scene involves the phoenix showing the eagle her gratitude for helping her... But she sounds totally different compared to the beginning.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's so clear that the Phoenix is slowly opening up to the other birds through her interactions with Rio.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's being so delicate, but it also feels completely natural. My mind's convinced that she's...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That she's...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You've proven that you may be worthy of being our rivals. But you'll need to maintain this standard for your next show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(She wasn't kidding that time...
Which is why I began believing that I was on the same level as Sakurako Seiryuin...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Then, before I knew it...
She had run so far ahead that I can't see her anymore...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought I was taking this so seriously...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But my confidence became so overinflated somewhere along the way that I'd lost sight...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I couldn't see just how much better everyone was getting...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They kept improving. A lot...
And I'm only realizing that now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm such an idiot...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: “Diving into an unknown world is terrifying, but not being able to because of my own fears would be much worse!”

rows.Speaker: Little Mermaid
rows.Line: “I'm going! I need to see him...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Knowing all that, do I still want to...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I don't wanna give up...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(After hearing Seiryuin sing...
It felt like she was showing me just how much of a skill gap there is between us... And it was so painful.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But... But...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to accept that fact because I won't be able to move forward if I don't!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I can't look away. I have to watch, listen and figure out what I'm missing or doing wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I mean, Tsukasa won the role of Rio because he was willing to put himself through a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Which means...
I also need to do absolutely everything I can to ensure that our show succeeds.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm gonna catch up to the others and show everyone that I am the Cowardly Canary...!)
A few days later
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I had the others listen to the way I sing in order to figure out what my habits are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...is about all I got.
Did I sound weird or off in any way...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I didn't really hear anything weird.
I thought you were really good, Nene. Your singing was as pretty as ever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm also struggling to find any such faults.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How about you, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
We practiced singing a few times during that workshop I attended...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm not sure any of the comments or criticisms I or the others there were given that time apply to you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Could you tell me what they told you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: One person was told, “To sing with a clearer voice from the opening” while another was, “Articulate better so that it's easier to discern the lyrics.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, neither of those really apply to Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As far as what the layperson would know, vibratos and glissandos also come to mind... But I can't think of much else...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're both an experienced stage performer and a talented singer, Nene. So, your “habits” may have nothing to do with your singing skills...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This has nothing to do with my singing skills...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone...
I know you're all busy working on your own roles, so I really appreciate your help.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't wanna take up more of your time, so I'll try giving this some more thought.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I still don't know what my habits are...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess this director was right. This isn't gonna be easy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh? It's getting light out...
I completely lost track of time while practicing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What time is it? Where's my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?! Thirty unread messages?!
From the Wonderlands×Showtime group too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Uh oh...
Did something happen without me realizing...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh?
There's a video here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Hiii, Neneee!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
<How's singing practice going?!
I hope you're not feeling too lonely.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Oh, I forgot. Robo-Nene's at home with you, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Emu, wait!
You're getting off track!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
<Ahem...
Today, Nene, we've put this video together in the hopes that it'll give you some encouragement!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
<We hope you get to watch this.
Now, it's showtime!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. They made this for me?
It's a cute video. I like how so many of the plushies are in it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hiya, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, they even got Miku and the others to join in...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Nene, we're all really looking forward to seeing your show☆>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <And please be sure to visit once it's over. We'd love to throw you all an after-party to celebrate a job well done.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <We hope that you figure out the solution to your problem and are able to put on a wonderful performance!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Hehe. None of us can wait to hear you sing your beautiful songs as the Cowardly Canary, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: <It pains us that we can't be of more help, but we're sure that you'll find a way...!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <We unfortunately won't be much assistance when it comes to singing. That being said, we're always willing to lend an ear to your worries.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Ready, everyone?! One, two...>

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
<You can do it, Nene!>
<You can do it, Neneee!>

rows.Speaker: Nene

rows.Speaker: Seiichi
rows.Line: As such, I believe actors who lose sight of that fact don't belong on stage.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. You and your stubborn stage philosophy. Still...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I hope you're right.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Break a leg, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Western Forest Swallow
rows.Line: “Hey, do any of you know about the really beautiful bird living deep within this forest?!”

rows.Speaker: Western Forest Swallow
rows.Line: “There's no one like her in the western forest. I wish there were a way for me to talk to her.”

rows.Speaker: Eccentric Crow
rows.Line:
“Do you speak of the phoenix?
You poor fool. She may look ravishing, but her heart is made of ice...”

rows.Speaker: Featherbrained Duck
rows.Line: “Oh, Swallow, that's right. It's only been two days since you came to this forest... Or was it a week? I forget...”

rows.Speaker: Gossiping Starling
rows.Line: “Regardless, allow me to tell you all about her. She's...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Their singing and acting is stupendous. I suppose they're nationally-renowned cast for a reason...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (But the meat of this show involves...)

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “That creature over there looks unfamiliar. So small and helpless... How repulsive.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “It must be a human. A child at that.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “My hate for it knows no bounds.”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (She was so little when I performed alongside her, but she definitely had this spark... Still, I never thought that she'd blossom like this so soon...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (There's no question that she's the future of show business. I can see why Nene was so anxious...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (But you also have some tricks up your sleeve now...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (So, show me what you've got!)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Wait, please... Phoenix!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The phoenix leaves Rio far behind and them becoming separated marks the end of the first act...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, which means...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The next scene's where Nene and Tsukasa meet for the very first time! I can't wait to hear her sing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, me neither.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(She's more focused that usual.
We probably shouldn't do anything to break her concentration.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In any case, we shall see what she's gained over this short period and how she performs...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll be on the edge of our seats...

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “No, I lost her again...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “At this rate, I'm never going to catch up to her, let alone capture her...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
If only I had wings like her...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that's Nene's cue...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The Cowardly Canary's personality involves “speaking through song”. Thus, her first line on stage it not spoken but sung.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Starting by humming.
Then, she slowly transitions to singing...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which reaches Rio's ears...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She sounds totally different compared to before...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, her tone's much lower.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's normal for anyone to believe that a canary would sing in a high pitch based on its natural size.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Nene initially went with that image during our practices it seems.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But she's lowered her tone...
Is it to conserve stamina? She likely won't have any trouble getting through this song now...)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Who's singing? Is it that bird...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“What a beautiful voice...
I'd like to hear it more up close...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“H-Huh?!
Who's there...?!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That felt...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
How did she do that?
Her line matched her singing so perfectly just now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it did...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, when the director said her singing “sticks out”, he meant that her acting and singing felt completely disconnected from one another.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She's thrown aside singing in a high pitch like a real bird and went with something closer to her regular voice.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A brave decision on her part...
As a result, her singing and acting are meshing together much nicer compared to when she was trying to “become a canary”.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, she sounds like a real canary that “speaks through song”.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I really like this version of her...
And she looks like she's having so much fun...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is Nene's Cowardly Canary...

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“U-Umm...
Thank you for praising my singing.”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“I really love to sing...
I mean, it's how I communicate.”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“No, it might be more than that...
Unfortunately, I'm not very good at talking to other people...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “But since you said that you enjoyed my song so much, I wouldn't mind singing another one for you...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “It's been so long since someone last heard me sing...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Good. Her training seems to be paying off...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (If she can keep this up, that other scene should be...)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Phoenix...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Wh-Why did you come back...?”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Here comes the climax...
Rio thought he'd never see the phoenix again after she dropped a feather for him to use to recover.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But his mother only has until sunset, which is just moments away. The phoenix appearing before Rio once more out of her own volition means...)

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“It is true that I wished to continue living.
However, I also enjoyed these past few days we spent together...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “You enjoyed spending time with me...?”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“No, that is not quite correct...
To be more precise, I enjoyed laughing and frolicking with you.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “However, if you lose your mother, that smile of yours will surely vanish along with her. If that were to happen...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “I would deeply regret not giving you my heart.”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Which is why...
I have decided that it is not worth living if it means you will no longer smile.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“So, take this knife...
Plunge it into me and take my heart.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“Hehe...
You truly are a weak, little coward.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “However, I shall leave you with some parting words.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Becoming friends with you filled me with so much joy...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“Wh-Why...?
Really? Now...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“What am I supposed to do...?!
How do you expect me to...?!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can feel Rio's pain wrapping itself around my heart...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Me too...
Seiryuin's also putting on a tremendous performance. Her voice and facial expressions are so captivating...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(These two really are something else.
They're the protagonists in every sense of the word.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However, one person must bring them together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(This is a key moment in the story...
A perfect performance will be required to compel these two to come to an agreement.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (So, we shall see how this plays out...)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“I'm sorry...
I'm so sorry, Phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “For my mom's sake... I... I...!”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “W-Wait...!”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“Please, wait...!
Stop, you two...!”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Fear not, Rio...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “I do not fear death for I am a majestic phoenix...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“I... I have to tell them...
They don't need a phoenix's heart to cure Rio's mother of her curse...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “My voice... I'm so scared...”

rows.Speaker: Witch
rows.Line:
“So, you have figured out my secret...
But if you tell those two, your life is forfeit!”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“I-If I tell them... She'll take my life...
But... But...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“Rio said that he likes my singing...
He became friends with me even though I'm afraid of just about everything...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“So, I... I don't want him to feel sad...
I don't want him to stab Phoenix...
I don't want him to stab his friend...!”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“I have to stop them...
I'll never forgive myself if I don't.”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line:
“But just telling them isn't going to work...
No, I can sing to them...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “With this song!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Her voice... It's going straight for my heart as it leaves her mouth, and I can feel her desperation so clearly...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I had no idea she could sing like this...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (She's overcome all of the walls she ran into during our training...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Youth really is a scary thing...)

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “This song...!”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“This must be that canary...
I believe she is trying to tell us something...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “What...? The heart of a phoenix is not required to dispel the curse that has been placed on Rio's mother...?”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Instead, we must defeat the witch...?!”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “R-Really...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “The witch had me fooled this whole time...?”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Phoenix, this means I don't have to use this knife anymore.”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line:
“Thank goodness...
I'm so relieved...”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Oh, for the love of... Why are you crying? Quickly now. Stand up.”

rows.Speaker: Rio
rows.Line: “Wait, what...?”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Time is of the essence for the sun will be setting soon. We must hurry and defeat the witch before then.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
“I shall follow you...
She will not be easy to fall, we should be able to win if we fight together.”

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: “Because we are friends...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (The entire audience has their attention focused on the stage...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (They even seem overcome with relief that Rio and the phoenix were able to find a solution...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: (Those two obviously did a magnificent job of immersing us into the story, but...)

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “Thank goodness...”

rows.Speaker: Cowardly Canary
rows.Line: “I'm so glad they heard my song...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: What an incredible performance.
Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see the show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We hope to see you again soon!

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: Oh, the cast members are thanking us. It must be because this is the anniversary show. I still can't believe how good it was!

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
The scene at the end with Rio and the phoenix totally blew me away. I felt so much empathy for them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The audience seems to have enjoyed our show very much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, and everyone did a really good job.
I think we put on a great performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was also able to give it everything I had.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Your singing was sooo amazing, Nene!
My heart went all bang-zoom-kapow and I...!

Yes.
You've improved quite a lot it seems.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Nicely done.
It was a wonderful performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Compared to before, your singing and acting were like night and day.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I never thought that you could improve so quickly in such a short period.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This was only possible because you went out of your way to contact Ms. Kazamatsuri for me. Otherwise, well...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, asking her to help you seems to have been well worth it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really genuinely thought that we put on an amazing show, and it was nice to be able to see what I was missing. As a result, I was able to give it absolutely everything I had today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Obviously, Seiryuin, I'm still nowhere near your level... But I'm really glad that I was given this chance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, thank you very much for giving me this opportunity to grow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Yes, well...
Let's just say that you owe me one now.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I disagree with your statement regarding you not being at my level.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Naturally, this show revolved around Rio and myself. After all, we are the main characters.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
However...
Your singing and acting gave us a massive boost.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My singing and acting...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Yes.
The scene where Rio hesitates to plunge his dagger into the phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: We were clearly one with the audience.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: One with the audience...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that scene was so immersive that those watching became a part of it. Almost as though we and the audience were in lockstep with the protagonists.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And what allowed that to happen was the Cowardly Canary's song.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My song...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Your song was so moving that it brought the entire venue together as one.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: As such, I disagree with your earlier statement.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Goodness, what am I saying?
Let's just say you owe me for this too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Anyway, what I'm trying to say is that you need to stop undermining yourself so much. That'll only cut off your potential. Once you understand that...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
I dare you to rise.
To my level.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Now, Wonderlands×Showtime, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Did you hear that, Nene?!
Sakurako Seiryuin just gave you a glowing review!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
She said that your song made our show what it is!
I'm so happy for you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really couldn't have done this without her.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Did Sakurako already leave?
I didn't get a chance to congratulate her!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ms. Kazamatsuri...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
You being here means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I-I-I-I-I-Is Mr. Amami also present here with you right now at this very moment?!?!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. As energetic as ever, I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry he's so obnoxious...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
I hardly consider that a bad thing.
I mean, he projects his voice so well.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
But I do need to apologize.
Seiichi just ran off saying that he had to use his quick pass for something called...the “fish coaster”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
That's unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Amami's going on the fish coaster...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A world-famous star riding the fish coaster... That's quite an image.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Anyway, enough about Seiichi...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Nene, congratulations on your performance. I'm so glad all that training paid off!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
You taught me so much, Ms. Kazamatsuri...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I was able to do my best as a result. It really felt like I grew and made some progress...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great to hear!
But...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You can't be satisfied with just this.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: All I did was teach you a few things, Nene. We weren't able to take a deeper dive because we were so short on time.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Yes, I taught you things that took me a very long time to learn. But that's just the tip of the iceberg...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: What you need to do moving forward is meet even more new people, learn as much as you can and use what you experience to grow even further.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To grow even further...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
That's right. So, you can't stop here.
Like I said before, Nene, you have nowhere to go but up.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to seeing just how much you've grown the next time we meet!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ms. Kazamatsuri...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you...
By the time we meet next...
I promise to have grown even more.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, thank you very much...
I really appreciate what you did for me this time around!
A few days later
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This area's all cleaned up now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa, how's your side going?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Swimmingly!
We should be done once I carry this ladder over!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, lemme help since it looks pretty heavy.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, excellent. Much appreciated!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know I say this every time, but it's always sad to see all the props and stuff get put away. It feels like this show's really over, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
It's sad to see this show in particular end since it was a joint production.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We may work together again someday, but it likely won't exactly be with the same group of people...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This show made me want to try performing with other people in different places.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Especially since Ms. Kazamatsuri said that I should and how I stand to grow from those experiences. I really wanna make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Without this show, I never would've realized just how much work I still needed or figured out what my habits were. And above all else, I wouldn't have gotten a chance to learn from Ms. Kazamatsuri.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I have to agree with you there...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, so...
I see now just how much time I've been wasting.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In hindsight, I let way too many opportunities to learn and grow go...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which is why I wanna start doing more like you, Tsukasa. I'm gonna start attending workshops, appearing in shows with other troupes and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: See more of the world we're in.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep experiencing new things, keep growing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And make my dream of becoming a world-class musical actress come true.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I know exactly how you feel.
I too wish to stand on top of this world of ours!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let us both do our best as we keep aiming for the top!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene and Tsukasa sound so optimistic about the future...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This show must've given them both a nice push.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've known Nene for quite a while now, but I'd never seen her shine on stage like that before...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me neither. Nene's singing and Tsukasa's acting were both so amazing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They sparkled so much...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When the time comes for them to say that they wish to leave the Wonder Stage, will you try to follow in their footsteps?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nope.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because my dream is to protect Grandpa's amusement park and keep it the way it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And make a place where everyone smiles!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
...
Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Emu has been saying that ever since we all met her, and has been unbending when it comes to this matter...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which is why we've been able to support her in her endeavors.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Emu's dream...
All our dreams... The only person who thinks we can make them come true together is...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We should hurry and get this all cleaned up before Nene and the others all go home without us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (My ego wishes for that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But is it right for me to do so...?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I should discuss this with “them”.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(To see what is the best path forward for us...
For Wonderlands×Showtime.)
